command_or_fixture: Prepopulate SkillRegistryTests._repo fixture with git show HEAD:.wavefoundry/framework/install/lifecycle-prompts/author-behavior-contract.prompt.md, run prime_profile_render and render_agent_surfaces, read resulting skill and prompt.
counterexample_or_failure_condition: The advertised inspection delegates solely to retained writing instructions with no inspection branch or canonical inspection fallback.
expected: Existing prompt bytes survive; explicit inspection reaches seed 230 inspection and finishes before authoring.
known_bad_detection_method: Injected prior installed authoring prompt in a real render and compared the advertised inspection route with the retained target.
limitations: Observed dispatch instructions. No assistant edits or data loss were simulated.
observed: Default and second-profile fresh installs passed. With the previous installed prompt retained byte-for-byte, generated skill advertised drift inspection but directed readers only to the local prompt; that prompt had no inspection branch and unconditionally directed them to update a contract in step 3. The skill explicitly says not to improvise its steps.
proposition: An explicit inspection through the rendered wf-contract skill reaches the read-only seed 230 procedure even if the installed author's backing prompt is retained.
safety_and_authorization: Only disposable render fixtures. Existing source and ledger untouched.

disposition_rationale: Repair the skill pointer for explicit inspection when the retained prompt lacks that branch, preserving ordinary authoring and retained bytes. Test with the older or project-customized writer prompt.
